source.n8nName: LINE Assistant with Google Calendar and Gmail Integration

setup: "Line Receiving" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

Workflow secret LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: LINE channel access token for api.line.me (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers, sessionId.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /linechatbotagent). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"AI Agent" kept conversation memory (memoryBufferWindow); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.

"AI Agent" used agent tools in the original: Wikipedia (toolWikipedia), Gmail Read (gmailTool), Google Calendar Read (googleCalendarTool), Google Calendar Create (googleCalendarTool). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached. Prefer connectors: googlesuper.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
